summary: Round 2 closes the prior critical retraction-consistency problem in the conclusions/proof state, fixes `docs/PHASE1_LOG.md` to Thm 12, and resyncs the PM-QKD table in `docs/findings/pareto_tf_family.md` with `docs/research/data/tf_family_loss1d.csv`. `CLAUDE.md` R0.1-R0.3 is broadly aligned with the existing FINDINGS/RETRACTION rigor framework. However, the branch is not review-clean yet: the workflow log is not accurate for current HEAD `37fa7df`, the conclusions doc now conflates path α and path γ against Log 07 / `umr_data_processing_gamma.md`, the new live `CLAUDE.md` reintroduces banned WTB 26/47 labels, and one reproducibility link in `pareto_tf_family.md` still points to a nonexistent file.

issues.description: The workflow audit trail for Round 2 is stale. It still identifies `2583ffc` as `HEAD` and as the Round 2 "this commit", but repository HEAD is `37fa7df`. The logged Round 2 file list also omits artifacts that were actually added in `37fa7df` such as `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/rules/research-rigor.md`, so the record does not accurately describe what Round 2 contained.
issues.suggestion: Update `workflow-log.md` so Round 2 is anchored to `37fa7df`, list the actual files added/changed in that commit, and adjust the final outcome text to match the true audited scope.

issues.description: §5 now correctly ends the v0.2 branch, but its forward-looking roadmap misstates path γ. It says path γ "must" prove the three trusted-relay monotonicity lemmas (protocol embedding / security reduction / rate-definition equivalence). Those lemmas are the path α requirements in Log 07 and in `docs/proofs/umr_data_processing_gamma.md`; path γ is instead the direct single-edge PLOB + explicit data-processing route. As written, the conclusions doc conflates α and γ and misdocuments the restart options.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite the path list so path α carries the three-lemma monotonicity package, while path γ is described consistently with Log 07 and `umr_data_processing_gamma.md` as the single-edge PLOB + data-processing approach.

issues.description: Round 1 issue 2 is not fully closed because the new live policy file still contains `WTB Thm 26/47` strings. The user’s cleanup rule allowed those stale labels to remain only in history/audit material, not in active guidance docs.
issues.suggestion: Remove the old theorem numbers from `CLAUDE.md` entirely, or move the historical example into an audit/history file and keep only the verified numbering (`Thm 12` / `Thm 19`) in live policy text.

round_recommendation: Update the workflow log to reflect commit `37fa7df`, fix the §5 path-γ description in the conclusions doc, remove stale WTB 26/47 labels from live docs like `CLAUDE.md`, and repair the remaining broken MDI reference link; then rerun the review.
